questions.question: If p:q=4:1, find (5p+3q):(5p-3q).
questions.questionHtml: If p:q=4:1, find (5p+3q):(5p-3q).
questions.solution:
Let p = 4k and q = k.

5p + 3q = 5×4k + 3×k = 20k + 3k = 23k.

5p − 3q = 5×4k − 3×k = 20k − 3k = 17k.

⇒ Required ratio = 23 : 17

questions.question: There are 6 consecutive integers and 5 consecutive integers. The average of the 6 integers is 2 less than the average of the 5 integers. The sum of the 5 integers is 4 more than the sum of the 6 integers. Find the average of the 6 integers.
questions.questionHtml: There are 6 consecutive integers and 5 consecutive integers. The average of the 6 integers is 2 less than the average of the 5 integers. The sum of the 5 integers is 4 more than the sum of the 6 integers. Find the average of the 6 integers.
questions.solution:
<svg width="500" height="240" viewBox="0 0 500 240" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">

  </defs>

  <!-- Zone 1: Average Visualization -->
  <!-- Set of 6 Integers -->
  <rect x="30" y="105" width="16" height="35" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="50" y="100" width="16" height="40" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <rect x="110" y="85" width="16" height="55" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="130" y="80" width="16" height="60" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="25" y1="92.5" x2="155" y2="92.5" stroke="#cc0000" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4,2"/>
  <text x="160" y="96" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#cc0000">Avg<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="10">6</tspan></text>
  <path d="M30,150 Q90,160 146,150" fill="none" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="65" y="172" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#2255cc">Sum<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="10">6</tspan></text>

  <!-- Set of 5 Integers -->
  <rect x="260" y="85" width="16" height="55" fill="#ede7f6" stroke="#6a1b9a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="280" y="80" width="16" height="60" fill="#ede7f6" stroke="#6a1b9a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="300" y="75" width="16" height="65" fill="#ede7f6" stroke="#6a1b9a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="320" y="70" width="16" height="70" fill="#ede7f6" stroke="#6a1b9a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="340" y="65" width="16" height="75" fill="#ede7f6" stroke="#6a1b9a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="255" y1="82.5" x2="365" y2="82.5" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4,2"/>
  <text x="370" y="86" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#007700">Avg<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="10">5</tspan></text>
  <path d="M260,150 Q310,160 356,150" fill="none" stroke="#6a1b9a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="275" y="172" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#6a1b9a">Sum<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="10">5</tspan> = Sum<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="10">6</tspan> + 4</text>

  <!-- Gap/Relation -->
  <line x1="210" y1="92.5" x2="210" y2="82.5" stroke="#cc5500" stroke-width="1.5" marker-start="url(#arrO)" marker-end="url(#arrO)"/>
  <text x="215" y="90" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#cc5500">+2</text>

  <text x="30" y="195" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ 5 × (A<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="10">6</tspan> + 2) = 6 × A<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="10">6</tspan> + 4</text>
  <text x="30" y="215" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ 5A<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="10">6</tspan> + 10 = 6A<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="10">6</tspan> + 4 ⇒ A<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="10">6</tspan> = 6</text>
  <text x="30" y="235" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">∴ Answer = 6</text>
</svg>

questions.question: A TV set is available for ₹19,650 in cash or for ₹3,100 as a cash down payment and three equal annual instalments. If the shopkeeper charges interest at the rate of 10% per annum compounded annually, calculate the amount of each instalment.
questions.questionHtml: A TV set is available for ₹19,650 in cash or for ₹3,100 as a cash down payment and three equal annual instalments. If the shopkeeper charges interest at the rate of 10% per annum compounded annually, calculate the amount of each instalment.
questions.solution:
<svg width="500" height="280" viewBox="0 0 500 280" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;padding:0;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arr" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#2255cc"/></marker>
    <marker id="arrG" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#007700"/></marker>
    <marker id="arrO" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#cc5500"/></marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- ZONE 1: COMPOUND INTEREST INSTALMENT MECHANISM -->
  <!-- TV Icon -->
  <rect x="20" y="20" width="80" height="50" rx="4" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="25" y="25" width="70" height="35" rx="2" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M50,70 L40,85 L70,85 L60,70" fill="#555555"/>
  <text x="110" y="45" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">TV: ₹19,650</text>
  <text x="110" y="65" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#cc0000">Down Pay: ₹3,100</text>

  <!-- Timeline & Compounding Steps -->
  <path d="M40,140 L440,140" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arr)"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="140" r="4" fill="#2255cc"/>
  <circle cx="180" cy="140" r="4" fill="#2255cc"/>
  <circle cx="300" cy="140" r="4" fill="#2255cc"/>
  <circle cx="420" cy="140" r="4" fill="#2255cc"/>
  
  <text x="50" y="155" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#555555">Now</text>
  <text x="170" y="155" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#555555">Yr 1</text>
  <text x="290" y="155" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#555555">Yr 2</text>
  <text x="410" y="155" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#555555">Yr 3</text>

  <!-- Growing Compounding Tiles (Discounting visual) -->
  <rect x="170" y="110" width="20" height="30" fill="#ccffcc" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="290" y="95" width="20" height="45" fill="#ccffcc" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="410" y="80" width="20" height="60" fill="#ccffcc" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <text x="170" y="90" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#007700" text-anchor="middle">10:11</text>
  <text x="300" y="75" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#007700" text-anchor="middle">100:121</text>
  <text x="420" y="60" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#007700" text-anchor="middle">1000:1331</text>

  <path d="M180,110 Q240,40 300,95" fill="none" stroke="#cc5500" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,2" marker-end="url(#arrO)"/>
  <text x="250" y="35" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#cc5500" font-weight="700">Equal Instalment (I)</text>

  <!-- ZONE 2: CALCULATION -->
  <text x="30" y="190" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Principal (P) = 19,650 − 3,100 = 16,550</text>
  <text x="30" y="215" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ 16,550 = I × [ (10/11) + (100/121) + (1000/1331) ]</text>
  <text x="30" y="240" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ I = 16,550 × (1331 / 3310) = 5 × 1331</text>
  
  <text x="30" y="268" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">∴ Answer = ₹6,655</text>
</svg>

questions.question: A gadget is sold at a 15% discount on its marked price. This sale leads to a profit of 20% on its cost price. If the profit earned is ₹450, what would have been the selling price if the gadget was sold at a 25% discount on its marked price?

<svg width="520" height="265" viewBox="0 0 520 265" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">

questions.question: A, B, and C can complete a certain task in 20, 30, and 60 days, respectively. How many days will it take for A to finish the work if he receives help from B and C every third day?
questions.questionHtml: A, B, and C can complete a certain task in 20, 30, and 60 days, respectively. How many days will it take for A to finish the work if he receives help from B and C every third day?
questions.solution:
LCM of 20, 30, and 60 = 60 ⇒ Total work = 60 units

A's 1-day work = 60 ÷ 20 = 3 units, B's 1-day work = 60 ÷ 30 = 2 units, C's 1-day work = 60 ÷ 60 = 1 unit

Work in 2 days = 3 + 3 = 6 units, Work on 3rd day = 3 + 2 + 1 = 6 units ⇒ Work in 3 days = 6 + 6 = 12 units

Number of 3-day cycles = 60 ÷ 12 = 5 ⇒ Total days = 5 × 3 = 15

questions.question: The ratio of the speeds of a car and a bus is 3 : 4. If the bus covers a distance of 320 km in 4 hours, what is the speed of the car in km/h?
questions.questionHtml: The ratio of the speeds of a car and a bus is 3 : 4. If the bus covers a distance of 320 km in 4 hours, what is the speed of the car in km/h?
questions.solution:
Speed of bus ⇒ 320 ÷ 4 = 80 km/h

Car speed ⇒ (80 × 3) ÷ 4 = 240 ÷ 4 = 60 km/h

questions.question: A tower stands 50 meters tall. From its peak, the angles of depression to the top and bottom of a nearby building are measured at 30° and 45°, respectively. Determine the approximate height of the building as well as the horizontal distance separating the tower from the building.
questions.questionHtml: A tower stands 50 meters tall. From its peak, the angles of depression to the top and bottom of a nearby building are measured at 30° and 45°, respectively. Determine the approximate height of the building as well as the horizontal distance separating the tower from the building.
questions.solution:
Let horizontal distance = x

⇒ tan 45º = 50 ÷ x ⇒ 1 = 50 ÷ x ⇒ x = 50 m

Let height of building = h

⇒ tan 30º = (50 − h) ÷ 50 ⇒ 1 ÷ √3 = (50 − h) ÷ 50

⇒ 50 − h = 50 ÷ √3 ⇒ 50 − h ≈ 50 ÷ 1.732

⇒ 50 − h ≈ 28.87 ⇒ h ≈ 50 − 28.87 ⇒ h ≈ 21 m

questions.question: A sphere is melted and recast into 8 identical cones, each with radius 3 cm and height 4 cm. What was the radius of the original sphere?
questions.questionHtml: A sphere is melted and recast into 8 identical cones, each with radius 3 cm and height 4 cm. What was the radius of the original sphere?
questions.solution:
Volume of 1 cone = (1/3)πr2h = (1/3)π(3)2(4) = 12π cm3

Volume of 8 cones = 8 × 12π = 96π cm3

(4/3)πR3 = 96π ⇒ R3 = (96π × 3) ÷ (4π) = 72 ⇒ R = 721/3 ≈ 4.16 cm

questions.question: The area of a regular hexagon is made of how many equilateral triangles?
questions.questionHtml: The area of a regular hexagon is made of how many equilateral triangles?
questions.solution:
Area of regular hexagon = 6 × Area of one equilateral triangle.

⇒ Number of equilateral triangles = 6.

questions.question: A circular fountain with a radius of 7 m is encircled by a grass bed that is 3.5 m wide. Determine the ratio of the area of the grass bed to the area of the fountain.
questions.questionHtml: A circular fountain with a radius of 7 m is encircled by a grass bed that is 3.5 m wide. Determine the ratio of the area of the grass bed to the area of the fountain.
questions.solution:
Outer radius = 7 + 3.5 = 10.5 m

Area of fountain = π × 72 = 49π

Area of outer circle = π × 10.52 = 110.25π

Area of grass bed = 110.25π − 49π = 61.25π

Required ratio = 61.25 : 49 = 5 : 4

questions.question: A tent designed as a triangular prism features a triangular base with an area of 20 m² and a height of 6 m. What is the volume of this tent?
questions.questionHtml: A tent designed as a triangular prism features a triangular base with an area of 20 m² and a height of 6 m. What is the volume of this tent?
questions.solution:
Given: Area of base = 20 m², Height = 6 m

Volume = Area of base × Height

⇒ Volume = 20 × 6 = 120 m³

questions.solution:
⇒ Number of pairs = 3(3 − 1) ÷ 2 = 3

⇒ Maximum tangents per pair = 4

⇒ Total maximum tangents = 3 × 4 = 12

questions.question: In a circle, chord AB and chord CD intersect at E such that AE : EB = 2 : 3 and CE : ED = 5 : 2. If AB = x and CD = y, which of the following is true?
questions.questionHtml: In a circle, chord AB and chord CD intersect at E such that AE : EB = 2 : 3 and CE : ED = 5 : 2. If AB = x and CD = y, which of the following is true?
questions.solution:
Let AE = 2k, EB = 3k, AB = 5k = x ⇒ k = x ÷ 5.

Let CE = 5m, ED = 2m, CD = 7m = y ⇒ m = y ÷ 7.

AE × EB = CE × ED ⇒ (2x ÷ 5)(3x ÷ 5) = (5y ÷ 7)(2y ÷ 7).

6x2 ÷ 25 = 10y2 ÷ 49 ⇒ 294x2 = 250y2 ⇒ 147x2 = 125y2 ⇒  \(\frac{x^2}{y^2} = \frac{125}{147}\)

questions.question: A chord in a circle with radius 10 cm subtends an angle of 90° at the center. What is the area of the minor segment?
questions.questionHtml: A chord in a circle with radius 10 cm subtends an angle of 90° at the center. What is the area of the minor segment?
questions.solution:
⇒ Area of sector = π × 102 × 90 ÷ 360 = 25π

⇒ Area of triangle = 1 ÷ 2 × 102 × sin90° = 50

⇒ Area of minor segment = 25π − 50
